body: #include <bits/stdc++.h>  // This will work only for g++ compiler.
#define for0(i, n) for (int i = 0; i < (int)(n); ++i) // 0 based indexing
#define for0N_1(i, n) for (int i = 0; i < (int)(n-1); ++i) // 0 based indexing 1 less than n
#define for1(i, n) for (int i = 1; i <= (int)(n); ++i) // 1 based indexing
#define for1N_1(i, n) for (int i = 1; i < (int)(n-1); ++i) // 1 based indexing 1 less than n
#define forc(i, l, r) for (int i = (int)(l); i <= (int)(r); ++i)
#define forr0(i, n) for (int i = (int)(n) - 1; i >= 0; --i) // reverse 0 based.
#define forr1(i, n) for (int i = (int)(n); i >= 1; --i) // reverse 1 based
// to be used with algorithms that processes a container Eg: find(all(c),42)
// find if a given value is present in a container. Container version. Runs in log(n) for set and map
// Avoiding wrap around of size()-1 where size is a unsigned int.
#define print_v(v) for(auto _i=0; _i<v.size(); ++_i) std::cout << v[_i] << (_i==v.size()-1 ? "" : " "); std::cout << endl;
